verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit's FAQ documents data-retention opt-out controls (opting out of all data retention on self-hosted Enterprise, and separately controllable model-output logging) and confirms code isn't used for model training, but this is narrower than a general telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out available to all users/tiers. Missing for 10: explicit mention of 'telemetry' or product usage-analytics opt-out (vs. just code data retention), and confirmation this opt-out is available outside self-hosted Enterprise.
